intro: The concept of biohacking helps us get to know our bodies better. It is a way to hack it using science and analytics. To start monitoring your body more carefully, you do not need to read endless studies and delve deeply. Special tools will be a great addition to your daily routine. Let’s talk about unique apps this time. Many of them can help you today with your progress activity check, medical support, and physical activity tracking. These applications collect, structure, and help analyze the physical indicators of the body and daily habits. Why not to try now?
highlights: Biohacking apps monitor sleep, diet, activity, mood, and biomarkers.
Apple Health and MyTherapy simplify health data tracking.
Sleep Cycle and Calm optimize sleep through sound and rhythm.
Strava and Nike Training Club guide workouts and performance.
FatSecret and Zero support smart eating and fasting habits.

blocks.text: Why do biohackers use apps

With biohacking apps, you can make and improve your life more comfortable. Many functions and tasks are now taken over by smartphone apps – they collect and store data from devices, provide ready-made programs and recipes, motivate, relax, and can even help you find new friends with similar sporting interests.

Biohackers improve the quality of their sleep, balance your diet, and even improve your mental health. For example, sleep monitoring apps can increase human productivity by 20-30%. This approach helps you to be more aware and control the processes in your body.
Many biohacking apps now will help you track your indicators, so sometimes, it is difficult to choose those that will be truly useful. There are many types of programs, both free and not.
Best biohacking apps by category
Every area of ​​life can be developed with the help of biohacking. And that’s why there are different types of special apps. Let’s put them into groups.
Health tracking and biomarker apps
This is the easiest way to improve health. These apps can track pulse, some of them could even show blood saturation or tell when exactly to take your pills. What are the examples?
Apple Health

This app can collect a personal medical card and track your daily activity, nutrition, sleep, menstrual cycle, ambient volume, and even headphones. In Apple Health, you can pull data from other health apps and create a single database.
MyTherapy

A biohacking tool that reminds you to take your medication, measure your blood pressure or blood sugar, and exercise. MyTherapy tracks the number of pills left and reminds you to refill your medicine cabinet if needed.
Water Meter
The app helps you control your water balance. Based on your parameters, it calculates the water you need and is notified when it’s time to drink.
Sleep and recovery apps
Everyone knows that to be in good shape, you must eat well and do some sports. Quite often, people forget about the essentials of sleep. Here are several ways to explore it better.

Biohacking For Better Sleep Blog, Health & Wellness, Sleep 19 min read Biohacking for Better Sleep Sleep is a physiological need for humans, just like hunger or thirst. If a person is deprived of sleep, he will eventually die. In ancient times, people considered sleep akin to death. After all, when a man lay in bed and closed his eyes, his breathing became less frequent and reduced […] [Read The Full Article](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-sleep)
Sleep Cycle
A tracking app that analyzes your sleep phases and wakes you up at the most appropriate moment. This biohacking tool collects your biometrics and circadian rhythms to help you tune them.
Pzizz
It uses music and sounds to improve sleep quality and relaxation. A few modules could help you enter a deep sleep phase or just help with napping.
Calm
A meditation and relaxation app that includes sleeping exercises. It tells exciting stories until you fall asleep.

It has been around for thousands of years. It came to us from ancient philosophical and spiritual teachings. The practice of mindfulness was primarily developed in Buddhism and Indian yoga, from where it […] [Read The Full Article](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-meditation)
Cognitive performance and meditation apps

It is a great way to [expand your cognitive abilities](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-to-biohack-brain-health). Cognitive performance and meditation apps are designed to improve mental clarity, focus, memory, and overall brain health while reducing stress and enhancing mindfulness. Here are some of the best apps in each category:
Forest

If you feel a lack of concentration, this biohacking app helps you optimize time and keep the focus on work with beautiful data visualization. Just set a timer, put the phone down, and a tree starts growing. If you get off task ahead of time, the tree dies. The app turns concentration into a game and adds motivation to work.
Meditopia
Meditopia has a huge number of meditations for different goals and tasks. You could use it to concentrate before work or after it for relaxation.
Daylio

This is an online diary in which you can record your mood, keep a habit log, set goals, mark what you did, attach a photo of the day, and write down important dates for you. The mood chart shows how often you feel unwell and whether you need help from a specialist.
Nutrition and fasting apps

[Healthy eating](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-diet) is one of the main factors for biohackers. You may also want to try fasting or some specific recipes. These apps can help you with everything!
FatSecret

An app for keeping a food diary. FatSecret reviews food from photos and reads barcodes. In addition to proteins, fats, and carbohydrates, the program helps you calculate how much sugar, salt, fiber, and cholesterol you have consumed. The app creates convenient reports on nutrition and activity for the day and the current and past weeks.
Zero

If you are interested in interval fasting, you should try this one. The app helps you track your fasting time and improve your results. It has a comprehensive interface and can make the fasting process easier for beginners.
MyFitnessPal

A nutrition and calorie tracking app lets you see your food intake, vitamins, and minerals. This biohacking tool will save you plenty of time by counting calories and balancing your eating routine, and it will also give you biofeedback.
Fitness and movement apps

Fitness and movement apps help users stay active, improve strength, flexibility, and endurance, and track their progress. Sometimes, tracking the productivity of sports activities by yourself can be difficult, so these programs could help.

Exercise is good for all areas of our physical health. It strengthens muscles and bones, improves mobility, and increases energy synthesis. Regular physical activity also positively affects our psychological well-being: it improves our mood, develops relationships with others, boosts confidence, and increases emotional control. Even regular walking and […] [Read The Full Article](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-to-strengthen-muscle-growth-using-biohacking-methods)
Strava

An app for athletes that helps with self-tracking during running, cycling, and outdoor activities. It can count your steps, track your geolocation, and even share photos from places you’ve been running or hiking.
Nike Training Club

An app with exercises for all fitness levels, including yoga and strength training. You can find various types of training for every age. The big plus of this app is the free version. Even there, you’ll find more than 100 training sessions, such as yoga, HIIT, recovery routines, etc.
JEFIT

A gym workout planner that maintains a database of exercises and workout routines. You must find some motivation here by sharing results with friends and tracking your progress. The app shows all improvements in your strength, endurance, and other metrics over time.
Tracking all of the above
If you don’t want to fill your entire phone with different apps, here are some alternatives combining several biohacking tasks that suit you.
Lifesum
This application tracks nutrition and physical activity. It provides personalized dietary recommendations, helps monitor macro- and micronutrients, and offers a training plan.
A user-friendly interface will be an advantage of this application. In addition, you will find delicious and healthy recipes in the application.
WHOOP

If you are also excited about your sleep, this biohacking app could be useful. Based on AI data, the application gives individual recommendations for recovery and training. A sensor measures physiological parameters, such as pulse and heart rate variability. Plus, it helps regulate workouts.
Chronometer

If tracking nutrition is one of the main tasks but you also want to keep track of the general condition of the body, Cronometer is the option for you. This app helps you track your calorie intake and understand how many macronutrients you consume. Cronometer integrates with fitness devices and other apps on a wearable and is customized for individual nutrition and health goals.
Trends in biohacking apps

As biohacking takes off, tendencies to optimize the apps and make them even more convenient are rising, so programs designed for cognitive enhancement, fitness, and overall well-being are evolving to become more personalized, data-driven, and convenient. Some key trends in biohacking apps include:

AI could be useful for experienced and newborn biohackers. These technologies help analyze all sorts of data about a person and convert it to profit. They mainly keep such data as sleep, workouts, or even DNA.

Biohacking apps are moving away from generic advice. Instead, they’re offering recommendations based on your unique data. For example, an app might tell you which foods work best for your body after a test. Or it might suggest specific supplements to meet your needs.

Another big trend is the rise of community features. Apps like Strava and MyFitnessPal now have social elements where you can share progress, join challenges, and get support from others. Tracking your journey is not just about connecting with people on the same path; it’s about connecting with people on the same path. It keeps you motivated and accountable.

Getting professional advice right through the apps is also becoming more common. You can now book virtual consultations with doctors, coaches, or nutritionists. They’ll use the data from your wearables or health apps to help you improve your biohacking plan.

Achieving optimal performance and well-being through biohacking requires a strategic approach. While technology and data-driven insights can help, the foundation of success lies in consistency, clear goal-setting, and proper nutrition. Here are some expert-backed best practices to maximize your results:

items: **Consistency.** Track your progress daily and monitor your results to stay on course and identify areas for improvement.
**Goal.** Setting specific, achievable goals boosts motivation and focus. Define a weekly target and work toward it consistently.
**Balanced Nutrition.** A well-rounded diet is essential for a healthy lifestyle. Monitor your intake of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates to support overall body function and performance.

blocks.text: Summary

Biohacking apps will help improve your life. These tools are becoming more innovative, more intuitive, and deeply personalized. With advancements in AI, real-time data tracking, and integration with wearables, they provide tailored recommendations to enhance your cognitive function, fitness, sleep, and overall well-being.

Community support and expert insights make it easier to stay motivated and make informed decisions about your health. Whether you’re optimizing your nutrition, tracking biometrics, or enhancing mental performance, biohacking apps empower you to take control and unlock your full potential.
